Reason for Mistake: This step prematurely narrowed the candidate set to only “Cheers” and “Bored to Death” and asserted Amazon Prime Video (US) availability without evidence, fabricating/misusing key data and omitting other multi-season Ted Danson series (e.g., Becker, Mr. Mayor, The Good Place).
